# How to PDF to Excel with Codex MCP and Medux

Learn how to use Codex MCP and Medux to extract tables from a pdf into an excel (.xlsx) file, including setup, request fields, tool approval, and results.

## Expected Medux tools

- `medux_pdf_to_excel`

## Prompt

```text
Extract tables from a PDF into an Excel (.xlsx) file.
```

## Review before approval

- `input_file_id` (required): Input PDF file id.
- `pages` (optional): Pages to extract, default all. Default: all.
- `flavor` (optional): Extraction method. Default: stream.
- `model_id` (optional): Model Default: pdf-to-excel-default.
- `title` (optional): Optional task title.

## Codex notes

- Use `/mcp` to confirm that Medux and the expected tools are available.
- Workspace paths must point to the intended local inputs and output directory.
- Review any network, shell, or filesystem approval requested during upload, download, or verification.
